definitions.explanation: the act of cleaning or wiping windows

examples.japanese: {窓拭|まどふ}きは{大掃除|おおそうじ}の{定番|ていばん}だ。
examples.english: Window cleaning is a staple of major house cleaning.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{窓拭|まどふ}きをする{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: I'm planning to clean the windows today.

examples.japanese: {新聞紙|しんぶんし}を{使|つか}うと{窓拭|まどふ}きが{簡単|かんたん}になる。
examples.english: Using newspaper makes window cleaning easier.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{窓|まど} (window) + {拭|ふ}き (wiping)

TOOLS:
- {雑巾|ぞうきん} - cloth/rag
- {新聞紙|しんぶんし} - newspaper (traditional Japanese method)
- スクイージー - squeegee
- ガラスクリーナー - glass cleaner

SEASONAL CLEANING:
{窓拭|まどふ}き is typically done during {大掃除|おおそうじ} (major cleaning) at year-end or spring cleaning.

SIMILAR ～{拭|ふ}き COMPOUNDS:
- {床拭|ゆかふ}き - floor wiping
- から{拭|ぶ}き - dry wiping
